I’m excited to share that I have joined Clinilabs, LLC as Chief Executive Officer! This next chapter in my career brings together many of the building blocks from my prior roles across clinical research, operations, sales and account management, commercial strategy, partnership development, and executive leadership. Throughout my career I have focused on building high performing, aligned teams that not only understand the strategy, but who feel connected to our mission and are empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes for the patients and clients we serve. I’m especially energized to join Clinilabs because of its focus in CNS, a therapeutic area that has long been deeply meaningful to me.
